alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Slit-Valve Oval Bezel because its non-magnetic permeability (µ <1.0001) eliminates interference with electron beam trajectories in vacuum processing chambers. The low sputter yield of Ti (0.3 atoms/ion at 500eV Ar+) compared to Al (1.2) reduces cross-contamination in thin-film deposition tools. Matched thermal expansion (8.6 µm/m°C) with ceramic end-effectors prevents particle generation during thermal cycling — critical for Oval slit-valve sealing bezel for wafer transfer. This rationale is driven by oval slit-valve sealing bezel for wafer transfer and specific design requirements.

faq.q: What metallic contamination levels are guaranteed for Titanium Slit-Valve Oval Bezel?
faq.a: Titanium Slit-Valve Oval Bezel is manufactured to ensure metallic surface contamination below 1×10¹⁰ atoms/cm² for Fe, Cr, Ni, Cu, and Zn per SEMI F108. Double VAR-melted starting stock ensures inclusion-free microstructure.
